name: narbomycin to H2O
summary: A 3-step route from narbomycin(1+) to H2O, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: pikromycin synthase
reactions.equation: narbomycin + 4 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 O2 + 4 H(+) = novapikromycin + 4 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 H2O
